categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: non-ferrous metal materials (hazardous solid waste resource products), filtration materials, and environmental governance (flue gas treatment engineering and urban-rural sanitation integration). These segments encompass hazardous waste disposal, high-temperature filtration materials production, and comprehensive environmental services including urban and rural sanitation projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary core technologies developed through its national enterprise technology center, postdoctoral workstations, and collaborations with universities. It specializes in high-performance high-temperature filtration materials with properties such as corrosion resistance and long service life. The company also develops integrated flue gas purification systems and hazardous waste resource recovery technologies, employing advanced smelting, roasting, and gas treatment processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as power generation, cement, steel, waste incineration, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, and urban sanitation sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on industrial clients requiring environmental protection solutions and hazardous waste management. Major customers include large power enterprises and steel manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant business in regions including Fujian, Jiangxi, Ningxia, Shaanxi, Hebei, and others. It also has international projects, including contracts in Thailand. The company’s subsidiaries and joint ventures are distributed across multiple provinces and cities in China, with some overseas presence through subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It manufactures filtration materials and hazardous waste resource products, provides environmental engineering services, and offers urban-rural sanitation services, positioning itself as an integrated environmental solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing filtration material technologies, expanding hazardous waste resource recovery, and enhancing environmental governance services. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on developing new high-temperature filtration materials, integrated denitrification and dust removal filters, and catalytic materials. It emphasizes innovation to meet stricter environmental standards and to capture growth opportunities in the green economy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of filtration materials and non-ferrous metal resource products, engineering project contracts for environmental governance, hazardous waste disposal services, and urban-rural sanitation service contracts. The company also earns income from trade and investment activities, with direct sales as the primary sales mode.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as a leading domestic brand in high-temperature filtration materials and holds a strong competitive position in flue gas treatment and hazardous waste disposal sectors. It faces competition from other environmental technology firms but leverages its technological advantages, comprehensive service offerings, and government policy alignment to maintain market relevance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 466 million, a 9.54% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 109 million, showing some improvement from prior losses. Total assets stood at around RMB 792 million, down 28.22% year-over-year. The company experienced operational challenges due to production halts and goodwill impairment but continues to invest in R&D and business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary core technologies, high-quality filtration materials with superior performance, and integrated environmental solutions that harmonize economic and environmental benefits. Its competitive differentiation lies in its technological innovation, comprehensive service chain from materials to engineering and sanitation, and alignment with national green development policies, enabling it to offer customized, efficient, and sustainable environmental protection services.
